title: Gunpowder crafted from Sulfur Recipe
description: This datapack adds a recipe for gunpowder to be crafted from sulfur and other ingredients
body:
### The long awaited recipe has finally come!

This datapacks adds a gunpowder recipe. It can be crafted from coal/charcoal, bonemeal and **potent sulfur**. Make sure you use **potent** sulfur and not just regular sulfur

![potent sulfur + bone meal + coal/charcoal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c828c4883df71a364ae7e551df6cd8ff50107165.png)
